title: Order Blocks vs Fair Value Gaps: Which One Actually Gets You Funded in 2026?
description: Order blocks or fair value gaps — funded traders are divided. R2F Trading breaks down which ICT concept wins for real entries. Watch before your next trade. Follow r2ftrading.com for daily setups.
